senses.zh_definition: 人名 Sheeni；已核实的文学用例包括《Youth in Revolt》中的角色 Sheeni Saunders。没有足够依据为小写 sheeni 赋予马来语普通词义。
senses.en_definition: A personal name, attested in the character name Sheeni Saunders in Youth in Revolt; no Malay common-word meaning has been established.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang, antaranya Sheeni Saunders dalam Youth in Revolt; makna sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum dapat disahkan.
senses.nuances: pos 为 noun，具体属于 kata nama khas。不能推定输入必然指该小说角色，也不能自动改成 sini、seni 或其他近形词。以下为专名使用示例，并非经统计的高频搭配。[出版社人物资料](https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/series/YR1/youth-in-revolt/)。

etymology.historical_story: Sheeni is documented as a character's given name in C. D. Payne's Youth in Revolt series: the publisher identifies Sheeni Saunders in its descriptions. This establishes a literary proper-name use, but neither explains the name's origin nor identifies the source of the supplied corpus token. Assigning it a Malay etymology would therefore be speculative. [Publisher evidence](https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/series/YR1/youth-in-revolt/).
